channel.title: Hudhud's Story Time
channel.description: Grandpa and Grandma tell true stories from islam.museum for curious kids: inventors, travellers, doctors and mapmakers from fourteen centuries of Islamic history. Every story links back to its page in the museum, where families can explore more in the Kids' Wing. Voices are AI-generated.
channel.itunes:author: islam.museum

item.title: The King Who Was Kind
item.description: Grandpa and Grandma tell the story of Salah al-Din, called Saladin, the sultan famous for his mercy: when he won back Jerusalem he kept its people safe, and when he died he left almost nothing behind. A true story from islam.museum, told for curious kids. Voices are AI-generated. Read the full story at islam.museum: https://islam.museum/en/person/salah-al-din-yusuf-ibn-ayyub/
